convert_mamba_ssm_checkpoint: convert a mamba_ssm checkpoint directory into HuggingFace FalconH1 format and save to output path
build_falcon_h1_config_from_mamba: build a FalconH1Config from a pretrained mamba_ssm model config with expanded intermediate size
map_mamba_ssm_state_dict_to_hf: map mamba_ssm state dict keys to HuggingFace FalconH1 naming convention using conversion mapping
split_attention_proj_weights: split a combined attn_proj weight tensor into separate q_proj, k_proj, and v_proj tensors
run_checkpoint_conversion_cli: run the checkpoint conversion script from command line with input and output directory arguments
